processes.name: Demand & Operational Inputs
processes.controls: Targets are the binding ceiling for all submissions
processes.description: Planning targets are released by Global Ops to the APAC region and the production volume target, reflecting demand from the External Sales Forecast, is published by GSC&S - the two feeds every planning stream consumes.
processes.owner: FP&A Ops (with Global Ops and GSC&S)
processes.window: Each planning cycle

processes.name: Operational Planning
processes.controls: EF sign-off of COGM, FMC changes in OPS Cube restricted to GFS SMEs and tracked, Total Project Cost must align to CAS approved amount, Site sign-off of expenses, CFO sign-off of FMC, Provision / MV changes after the soft-lock date need Inventory Finance Director approval
processes.description: Volume and COGM modelling, logistics and warehouse costs, workforce and OPEX, CAPEX, product costing and inventory are planned in parallel streams that converge on the site P&L. Cost & Resource Planning activities were merged into Operational Planning at the LT review.
processes.owner: FP&A Ops (with EF, GSC&S, PC CoE, CAPEX, Global Logistics Finance)
processes.window: Each planning cycle

flows.name: Operations Planning – Volume & Cost of Goods Manufactured modelling

processes.name: P&L Modelling & Forecasting
processes.controls: P&L-to-FMC reconciliation mandatory, CPU costs and volumes reconcile to the site submission, Steerco approval for input changes after submission dates
processes.description: Productivity bridges, the P&L-to-FMC reconciliation and the cost-per-unit analysis explain the submission; the site P&L is finalised in Hyperion with the Lean P&L, actualized from MEC and packaged with bridges and CAPEX slides into the review packs under the cycle governance.
processes.owner: FP&A Ops (with EF, Global Ops)
processes.window: Each planning cycle

processes.name: Planning Review and Sign-Off
processes.controls: Email approval by OPS Performance Director (P&L) / Inventory Finance Director (MVs, provisions) after soft lock, OPS Cube close
processes.description: Site reviews with RFDs challenge the forecast and productivity, post-review adjustments are reloaded, the Planning Hub is soft-locked under change control, regional packs and productivity bridges are reviewed and the OPS Cube is closed for the Group submission, which becomes the planning comparator for month-end reporting.
processes.owner: EF / Site CFO/RFD / FP&A Ops / Global Ops
processes.window: Each planning cycle

flows.name: Planning Review and Sign-Off (Site → Region → Group)

processes.name: Month-End Actualization
processes.controls: Pre-close data integrity checks (SOP task 1A / 1B), Manual journal preparation, approval and posting follow MU / GFS rules, SAP sign-off; balance sheet review; controls attestation
processes.description: Pre-month-end checks, month-end journal posting and process order settlement, the preliminary P&L preparation and the final SAP → SOAR → FDH → ASO reconciliation deliver the actual P&L, validated with EF and the site CFO for SAP sign-off (WD2) and FDH close (WD4).
processes.owner: FP&A Ops (with EF, R2R, CAPEX, P2P)
processes.window: Intra-month to WD+4 (monthly)

flows.name: Month-End Close: Pre-close, Journals & SAP Close

processes.name: Variance Analysis
processes.controls: Input to SOX and FCF controls
processes.description: GFS analysts analyse actuals against the planning comparator line by line - volume and COGM at standard, PPV / ROX / yield, manpower and non-manpower, CAPEX and depreciation, inventory write-offs and provisions - and conclude the Ops P&L variance that feeds the commentaries and the SOX / FCF controls.
processes.owner: FP&A Ops
processes.window: WD+2 – WD+4 (monthly)

processes.name: Performance Reporting
processes.controls: P&L control Core FSC009-001 (site MI Pack as evidence), Pre-read and sign-off evidence for Core FSC009-001
processes.description: Analysts conclude root causes and write the commentaries into the site MI Pack (Commentary Preparation, consolidated into Performance Reporting at the LT review); the pack is reviewed with EF, signed off by the site CFO / Head of Finance and consolidated to regional level by AI Agent Rhy for the Global OPS Performance Pack.
processes.owner: FP&A Ops / EF / Site CFO/RFD
processes.window: WD+2 – WD+5 (monthly)

flows.name: MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional)

processes.name: Leadership Insights & Decision Support
processes.description: Approved regional MI Packs and the Global OPS Performance Pack reach leadership; insights and actions flow back into weekly tier meetings, the next month-end close and the next forecast cycle, where monthly reporting is measured against the planning comparator.
processes.owner: GRT / EF
processes.window: WD+5 onwards

processes.description: Monthly SOA, pre-due reminders and payment chasing with escalation. Disputes and deductions are recorded, investigated and resolved by credit note or invoice correction.
processes.owner: O2C Collection team
processes.window: Daily; monthly SOA and reminders · Semi-automated · High Radius, SAP

processes.name: Payment allocation / cash application
processes.description: Daily bank statements feed High Radius, which auto-matches payments to invoices and posts the output file to SAP. Unmatched payments are checked and cleared manually.
processes.owner: O2C Cash Application team
processes.window: Daily · Semi-automated · High Radius Cash Application, SAP

processes.name: Cash & Banking
processes.description: Outgoing payments run through the SAP payment run or the manual route in Crown. Bank statements are posted, open items cleared and the bank reconciled in BlackLine.
processes.owner: O2C Cash & Banking team
processes.window: Daily · Semi-automated · SAP, Crown, FIS Payment Hub, bank portals, BlackLine
